svg.title: A CPU core compared with a streaming multiprocessor: the core has a large out-of-order engine for one or two hardware threads; the SM has four sub-partitions, each with a simple warp scheduler, a 64 KB register file and 32 lanes, and keeps up to 64 warps resident
svg.text: front end: fetch, decode, branch prediction
speculates far ahead along the predicted path
picks any ready instruction of 1-2 threads
L1 data cache 48 KiB · L2 cache 1 MiB
one thread runs fast: up to ~8 instructions per cycle
L1 cache + shared memory: 256 KiB, split configurable
each scheduler issues 1 instruction per cycle for one warp of 32 threads,
in program order - from whichever of its warps is ready
numbers are typical for current server parts; consumer GPUs and other CPUs differ in the details
